run_display_data_cli: run the display_data CLI to iterate through and print all registered diplomacy tasks for verification
run_register_all_agents: run register_all_agents to import and register all diplomacy agent modules including integration tests and generators
run_register_all_tasks: run register_all_tasks to import and register all diplomacy task modules including dialogue and order tasks
review_display_data_entry_point: review the display_data entry point that seeds random and invokes DisplayData.main from ParlAI
test_display_data_iteration: test the display_data script to verify data loading and iteration across registered diplomacy tasks
